author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Autumn quince harvest brings a beautiful golden color and rich seasonal aroma to the village 🍁🍂 In this video, we gather ripe quinces and turn them into delicious winter preserves and a warm homemade pie.

The fruit is carefully prepared and preserved so its unique sweet-tart flavor can be enjoyed during the colder months. We also use fresh quince for a rustic homemade pie, baked until beautifully golden and fragrant.

Quince season is a wonderful time for traditional village cooking and winter preparation. Fresh fruit, homemade preserves, and simple autumn baking come together in a cozy celebration of the harvest and the comforting flavors of the season. 🥧🍐🌿
title: Quince Harvest Season | Winter Preserves & Homemade Pie. 🍁🍂🥧
